phase: Frozen before new markout fixture tests, production candidate, numerical metric/retained outcomes or CI300 wiring runs. Source/docs and previous exposed studies reviewed only.
question: Can fixed-horizon, observed-quantity markout diagnostics preserve economic unit exposure under identical-fill splitting and reveal horizon/censoring support, without changing execution/raw markouts or pretending the pooled legacy scalar is an economic decomposition?

hypotheses.H1: Fixed single-horizon base legacy proxy +10 versus split -2 despite same qweighted observed amount -2 and mean_ticks-.8. New quantity-weighted values and quantity coverage invariant to split; event means and fill counts legitimately change.
hypotheses.H2: Adding/multiplying a requested horizon changes legacy pooledproxy but must not alter another horizon’s new summary. Duplicated identical(fill,horizon) rows count once only in new summaries; keep rawrows,config and legacy means/proxy unchanged.
hypotheses.H3: Late censored quantity must lower coverage, never scale the observed aggregate. Per-horizon support can differ; all missing is null/zero coverage, genuine observed zero remains numeric zero. Missing row counts as unobserved in an identified horizon.
hypotheses.H4: Normal full backtest new metrics follow the same raw-row oracle; all eight Parquet tables/execution/source/config/event/nonclock diagnostics and nonmarkout metric values remain unchanged. Retained effects may be positive, zero or mixed; never a publication-sign gate.

target_estimand.grouping: Separate each positive horizon_ns; within it all fills, bid and ask. No pooled multi-horizon amount and no summation across horizons.
target_estimand.universe: Authoritative unique fill IDs with positive builtin-integer quantity and side1/-1. For each horizon identified in supplied markout rows, totalq includes all fills in the group whether their row/outcome is missing. With no fills/rows, no configured horizon can be inferred: empty horizon table.
target_estimand.observation: An unambiguous joined fill/horizon outcome with BOTH finite markout_ticks and finite per-unit markout_value. Preserve existing compute_markouts first-true-midpoint-at-or-after convention. No stale-price/clock correction in this study.
target_estimand.formula: Qobs=sum quantity over unique observed fill IDs; A=sum q_i*markout_value_i (currency); tick_total=sum q_i*markout_ticks_i; qmean_ticks=tick_total/Qobs; qmean_value=A/Qobs; quantity_coverage=Qobs/Qall. Qmissing=Qall-Qobs. Distinct event counts need not be split invariant.
target_estimand.null_policy: Qobs0 => means and observed amount null, not zero. Qall0 => coverage null. Valid observed zero remains0. No extrapolation to censored quantity, missing-price imputation or causal adverse-selection claim.
target_estimand.joins: Require unique authoritative IDs/positive integer qty/side. Markout IDs resolve and sides agree; supplied fill_timestamp_ns/fill_price_ticks agree. Positive nonboolean integer horizons. Collapse identical or consistently identical normalized missing-outcome duplicate requests within (fill,horizon); conflicting outcome/identity/future-reference duplicates reject. No config or compute_markouts validation change.

candidate_semantics.production_scope: metrics.py only. Optional private aggregation helper and new output metadata/table. No strategy/risk/portfolio/matching/markout raw computation/report plot/schema changes; docs may clarify conventions.
candidate_semantics.output: execution_quality.markout_summary_by_horizon_ns maps horizon string to all/bid/ask records, each with total_fill_quantity,observed_quantity,missing_quantity,quantity_coverage,total_fill_events,observed_fill_events,missing_fill_events,quantity_weighted_markout_ticks,quantity_weighted_markout_value,observed_markout_value. Empty group coverageNone; observed sumNone when no observations.
candidate_semantics.legacy: Preserve exactly execution_quality.markout_ticks_by_horizon_ns and markout_ticks_by_side; label as event-row means/pooledrowmeans. attribution.adverse_selection_markout becomesNone with explicit nullable/unidentified explanation. Preserve EXACT old numeric formula under attribution.legacy_pooled_markout_proxy, clearly labeled not additive/causal. Other attribution components/ledger identities unchanged.
candidate_semantics.limits: Observed gross fill-to-future-midpoint values include entry spread and depend on first-after timing; not pure adverse drift, realized/terminal Pnl, net costs, statistical uncertainty or market-making advantage. Unequal horizon coverage prevents a common-population decay interpretation.
